blocks.raw: Call tasks are the messages which are sent to the store staff. These messages are suggestions/instructions for the store staff.
blocks.text: Call tasks are the messages which are sent to the store staff. These messages are suggestions/instructions for the store staff.

blocks.raw: You can create a call task content only under the message creation section. To create a call task content, click the **Campaign** tab on Dashboard, and then click **Create campaign**. For details on campaign creation, see [create campaign](https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/create-a-campaign) flow.
blocks.text: You can create a call task content only under the message creation section. To create a call task content, click the Campaign tab on Dashboard, and then click Create campaign. For details on campaign creation, see create campaign flow.

blocks.raw: To create a new call task content, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To create a new call task content, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. On the **Creative templates** page, click the **Call Task** tab.
2. In **Add creatives**, select your preferred call task template or create a new call task template.
blocks.text: On the Creative templates page, click the Call Task tab.In Add creatives, select your preferred call task template or create a new call task template.

blocks.raw: To create a new call task, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To create a new call task, follow these steps.

blocks.raw: * In the **Call Task** tab, click **New Call Task**.
blocks.text: In the Call Task tab, click New Call Task.
